sources.quote: 💰 DeepSeek API prices drop 50%+, effective immediately.
sources.supports: DeepSeek itself announced an API price reduction effective immediately in 2025; this corroborates that its API prices changed, though this page does not specify the earlier model-specific rates.

The provider's April 24, 2026 announcement says its API was updated and available that day; the URL date and contemporaneous announcement support the effective day associated with the new pricing record.

notes: The provider's dated April 24, 2026 V4 announcement says the API update was available that day, consistent with a real provider change rather than a models.dev correction. The archived pricing-page CDX query was unavailable (503); no accessible primary source here gives exact pre-change rates or brackets the pricing-page transition, so effective precision is limited to the announcement day.
